summary: Frontend-only E2E test of the three AI-assistant enhancements (auto-suggest toggle, reply variations/Regenerate, WhatsApp inbound badge + sorting). ALL primary flows PASSED end-to-end against the public preview URL. Draft-only — no send buttons clicked (M365/Twilio LIVE).

integration_issues.issue: After auto-suggest populates wa-reply-input, wa-ai-draft-btn.innerText was captured as empty string (mail-ai-draft-btn correctly shows 'Regenerate'). Regenerate action still works and produces a different draft. Likely icon-only button or label not synced with reply-non-empty state for WA. Minor/inconsistency vs Mail.

action_items: Minor: WhatsApp AI draft button (wa-ai-draft-btn) does not appear to update its label to 'Regenerate' when wa-reply-input is non-empty (innerText read as ''). Align WA button UX with Mail so admins get the same 'Draft with AI' → 'Regenerate' cue.
critical_code_review_comments: Auto-suggest works reliably (~2-8s latency) and Regenerate consistently returns semantically different wording — good use of avoid_draft on the backend.
72 conversations show 'Reply needed' badges and they float to the top of the WA list as designed. Ordering looks correct on the first 10 items.
Small consistency gap: Mail button toggles label to 'Regenerate' but the WA button doesn't (or is icon-only). Consider matching them for admin UX parity.
seed_data_creation: None. Autosuggest was toggled ON, tested, and toggled OFF again (cleanup verified).
